hero.title: Products & Services
hero.description: Delta Seikan provides comprehensive metal packaging solutions, from 2-piece and 3-piece aluminum cans to high-tech coating services, meeting the strictest food industry standards.

trangPhu.title: Metal Coating Service
trangPhu.desc: Delta Seikan provides metal coating services using advanced technology from KBA - LTG (Germany), ensuring high adhesion, superior corrosion resistance, and food safety. The products meet strict international standards such as BPA-NI and PFAS-free, making them suitable for the food industry.

lon2manh.title: 2-Pieces Can – DRD can
lon2manh.desc: 2-pieces can (DRD – Drawn & Redrawn) are manufactured using advanced deep-drawing technology, optimizing mechanical strength, minimizing seams, and ensuring absolute airtightness. Suitable for canned food, providing high preservation efficiency and production cost optimization.

lon3manh.title: 3-Pieces Can
lon3manh.desc: 3-pieces can consist of body, bottom, and lid, joined by modern welding technology, ensuring high tightness and durability. Flexible solutions in size and capacity, suitable for many products in the food industry.

napEOE.title: EOE Lid
napEOE.desc: The EOE lid is designed with an easy-open mechanism, providing a convenient user experience while ensuring airtightness and product safety. Manufactured to international standards, this product is suitable for a wide variety of food cans.

dichVu.title: PACKAGING AND DISTRIBUTION
dichVu.desc: To ensure the quality and safety of finished goods during storage and transportation , professional packing solutions that are easy for operation and environmental friendliness are provided.
dichVu.i1Desc: Strict control process, ensuring product quality and safety.
dichVu.i2Desc: Flexible design, easy to integrate into production systems.
dichVu.i3Desc: Solutions aimed at minimizing environmental impact.
